result.artifact:
SELECT month, region, total_sales
FROM (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', ordered_at) AS month,
    region,
    SUM(amount) AS total_sales,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC) AS rnk
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY month, region
)
WHERE rnk <= 2
ORDER BY month, rnk;
